verdict.rationale: Plausible has some automation-like features, such as scheduled email and Slack reports and traffic spike notifications, so asking whether those can be managed over time is a fair question for an analytics product. The evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations or configuration. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
